notes: Route: library/:libraryId (guards authGuard, libraryAccessGuard; resolver libraryResolver) with child series/:seriesId (resolver seriesResolver) in app-routing.module.ts:99. Guards and resolvers run before ngOnInit, so they are steps with no parent.

ngOnInit also subscribes to MessageHubService.messages$ (series-detail.component.ts:547) and to route.fragment (601); both only react to later events and are not followed. The SignalR events it reacts to (SeriesRemoved, ScanSeries, CoverUpdate, ChapterRemoved, VolumeRemoved, SeriesUpdated, ExternalMetadataUpdate, NotificationProgress) are sent from other flows.
The constructor (499) registers bulk-selection callbacks and sets routeReuseStrategy.shouldReuseRoute; no requests. ngAfterViewInit only sets the scroll container.
The first loadSeries runs 300 ms after ngOnInit (debounceTime), with loadExternal true, so loadPlusMetadata runs; later reloads (SignalR events) pass false.
All [SeriesAccess] endpoints share the filter in EntityAccessAttribute.cs; its HasAccessToSeries check is not repeated as a step per endpoint. Admins skip the check.
loadSeries also reads the series from the resolver result (getResolvedData); the extra getSeries call at 645 repeats the resolver's request.

Not followed: LocalizedNamingContext and volume/chapter formatting inside SeriesService.GetSeriesDetail (600-626); BookmarkDto/SeriesRelation mapping details; child components' own requests (cards, tabs, detail drawers) that start after the screen renders.
Frontend base URL is environment.apiUrl ('.../api/'), so paths are under /api.
